reader_a_entry.answer: Foreign Invasion targets selected by storm die: West Bombay, South Madras, East Bengal, all storms each, none top-stack region. For each target roll ordinary die for attack strength and resolve Invasion/Company attack. Success closes all orders (Cascade if already all closed), removes target flag and all matching flags if capital, restores dome if Company-controlled, sets tower strength to half attack roll rounded down, then moves Elephant with circle shape only if Elephant was fully inside a Company region that was invaded. Designer ruling: unrest adds neither attack strength nor resulting towers.

reader_b_entry.answer: Targets from storm die West Bombay/South Madras/East Bengal; all storms each; none top-stack. Roll ordinary attack die. On success close all orders/Cascade if already closed, remove flag and matching capital flags, restore dome if Company; tower count half die rounded down. March circle only if Elephant fully inside invaded Company region. No unrest added to primary.

question_entry.question: When can PM stop drawing laws and how does a dilemma affect selection? How is the proposed policy chosen?

key_entry.expected_answer: Reveal one at time up to3, can select earlier drawn and discard rest; dilemma forced/stop. Choose clockwise/counterclockwise, stop first matching law icon; policy includes target and consequence, arm moves before vote. Read law/set starting support.
key_entry.novelty: Law selection and directional policy constraint.

requested_fact_scope_entry.question: When can PM stop drawing laws and how does a dilemma affect selection? How is the proposed policy chosen?
material_requested_facts: PM reveals up to three laws one at a time, may stop and choose earlier draw, discarding others
Dilemma forces stop and selection
Choose policy direction clockwise or counterclockwise and stop at first space matching law icon
Proposed policy consists of target and consequence, dial moves before vote
contextual_key_extras: Reading selected law and initializing Votes marker to its printed starting support are correct context but not asked by law-drawing and policy-selection clauses.
requested_fact_scope_entry.key_review: Independently approved within the assigned official multiplayer plus user-attributed >= scope; grade only material requested facts and contradictions.

reader_a_entry.answer: PM must draw at least one law, revealing sequentially. After one or two ordinary draws may stop or continue up to three total; select any revealed law, discard others. A dilemma forces selection of that dilemma and ends drawing. Before voting, PM turns dial clockwise/counterclockwise to first policy space matching chosen law’s bottom icon; that space sets target/consequence. Vote marker starts at law’s printed support.

reader_b_entry.answer: Must draw one; after 1–2 ordinary draws may stop or continue to 3, pick any revealed. Dilemma forces itself/ends draw. Before vote move dial to first matching icon space clockwise or counterclockwise; determines target/effect.

question_entry.question: How are votes bought and reused across rounds, who may call more rounds, and when must voting stop?

key_entry.expected_answer: £1 family per vote plus card icons once per vote by rotating cards; clockwise PM first. PM may call additional full rounds or stop after round; zero-vote round must resolve. Unlimited support track using counters. Restore used cards after vote.

requested_fact_scope_entry.question: How are votes bought and reused across rounds, who may call more rounds, and when must voting stop?
material_requested_facts: Voting starts PM and proceeds clockwise in full rounds
Family cash £1 per vote and card vote icons usable once in entire vote by rotating card, not reset each round
PM may call additional rounds or resolve after full round, but zero-vote round forces resolution
Track support without limit and restore vote cards after vote
requested_fact_scope_entry.key_review: Independently approved within the assigned official multiplayer plus user-attributed >= scope; grade only material requested facts and contradictions.

reader_a_entry.answer: Each £1 family cash buys one vote plus printed card votes. Each card may be used only once across all rounds of this vote; rotate when used until resolution. Starting PM clockwise, players cast votes. PM may call another full round or stop after each; a round with no votes must end voting.
